answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 51922 Country: India Title: Doing Qurbani on Eid ul Azha without my Aqiqa. Question: Can I do qurbani on Eid al-Azha with my name without my aqiqah? Answer ID: 51922 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 811/683/B=05/1435) Yes, you may do qurbani on the occasion of Eid al-Azha in your name though your aqiqah has not been done so far. It is correct without any karahat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
